more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Potassium metabisulphite is used as a preservative in food. Its technological role is to help limit microbial spoilage.
more_info.daily_intake:
0–0.7 mg sulphur dioxide equivalents/kg body weight/day, combined JECFA sulphite group (JECFA, 1998).
EFSA withdrew its temporary group ADI in 2022.
more_info.side_effects:
Food-use exposure may concern high consumers (EFSA, 2022).
Toxicology gaps prevented a new intake limit.
